title: NIAB Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Project Associate Posts
description: National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (NIAB) has released an official notification for the recruitment of various Project Associate Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in M.E/ M.Tech, M.V.Sc, or M.Sc can grab this chance and apply for the NIAB Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online by the last date of application...
